offers.name: Read the payment methods
offers.description: Other products read which manual payment methods the website offers.

offers.name: Create payments
offers.description: Other products start a payment or checkout for an order.

offers.name: Read payments
offers.description: Other products read a payment and check it against what they expect.

offers.name: Cancel unpaid payments
offers.description: Other products cancel a payment that is not paid yet.

offers.name: Refund payments
offers.description: Other products refund a payment, with a signed-in staff member.

offers.name: Read permissions
offers.description: Other products list this product's permissions, for the roles of the website's staff.

offers.name: Export a person's data
offers.description: Other products ask this product for everything it keeps about one person.

offers.name: Erase a person's data
offers.description: Other products ask this product to erase or anonymize one person's data.

features.name: Stripe
features.description: Card and wallet payments on Stripe Checkout with the merchant's own Stripe keys; also Stripe subscriptions.

features.name: PayPal
features.description: PayPal checkout with the merchant's own PayPal app; also PayPal subscriptions.

features.name: PayFast (South Africa)
features.description: Payments on PayFast South Africa's own page (payfast.co.za, ZAR) with the merchant's own PayFast account.

features.name: PayFast (Pakistan)
features.description: Payments on PayFast Pakistan's hosted checkout (gopayfast, PKR) with the merchant's own PayFast account.

features.name: JazzCash (Pakistan)
features.description: Payments on JazzCash's hosted checkout with the merchant's own JazzCash account.

features.name: Easypaisa (Pakistan)
features.description: Payments on Easypaisa's hosted checkout (Easypay) with the merchant's own store.

features.name: Rapid Gateway (Pakistan)
features.description: Payments on Rapid Gateway's hosted checkout (card, Easypaisa, JazzCash, Raast; PKR) with the merchant's own Rapid account.

features.name: Manual payment methods
features.description: The merchant's own ways to pay outside a gateway (bank transfer, pay on delivery, pay at pickup …): their details, instructions and accounts; payers may upload a proof to the merchant's own storage and the merchant confirms receipt.

features.name: Custom gateways
features.description: Up to 5 gateways of the merchant's own (generic:<key>), each in its own connection: the payer is sent to its checkout address with signed fields and it confirms with a signed notice.

features.name: Payment links
features.description: Reusable links for any amount (invoices, bookings, donations), with a hosted page and the pay button.

features.name: Merchant payment API
features.description: The merchant's server (and Ecommerce through a pasted token) creates, reads and verifies payments; the Payments admin widget.

features.name: Subscriptions
features.description: Gateway-managed subscriptions on Stripe and PayPal; Payments mirrors their status; the Subscriptions admin widget.

features.name: Refunds
features.description: Full and partial refunds by API or the Payments admin widget, recorded in the payment's history.

permissions.name: Create and turn off payment links
